title: Passives: the nodes of the trees
summary: 74 passives: permanent bonuses unlocked with skill points in the class trees and the General tree.

blocks.text: A passive is a permanent bonus: more health, more damage, faster cooldowns... Each has several levels, a cost per level and a requirement (another node at maximum level). Points can be refunded with a skill tree reset (150 shards per point).

blocks.text: Some nodes are Human only (the unawakened keeps the whole General tree) and some are exclusive : you cannot take both.
